title: UP Income / Cast / Domicile Certificate Online Verification 2021
postName: Online Verification of Income, Caste & Domicile Certificates
documentsRequired: Application number, roll number, DOB, registered email/mobile
howToApply:
1. Visit https://edistrict.up.gov.in
2. Open Certificate Verification / Status
3. Enter certificate / application number
4. View verification result
5. Download digitally signed certificate if available
shortDescription: UP Income, Caste, Domicile Certificate Online Verification – verify e-District certificates on edistrict.up.gov.in.
content:
Uttar Pradesh Income, Caste and Domicile (Residential) certificates issued via e-District can be verified online.

Employers and institutions should use the official verification page with certificate number. Citizens can also re-download certificates from their e-District login.
